# UFO Declassified

UFO Declassified is an independent public archive of declassified UAP/UFO records released under the PURSUE initiative beginning on May 8, 2026, with Release 02 added on May 22, 2026.

The site is designed for research, citation, and source review. It indexes PURSUE Release 01 and Release 02 records from U.S. government source groups including the Department of War, FBI, NASA, Department of Energy, CIA, ODNI, Department of State, National Archives, and other public sources.

## Recommended Entry Points

- Home: https://ufo-declassified.com/
- Document Database: https://ufo-declassified.com/documents
- Research Topics: https://ufo-declassified.com/topics
- Source Agencies: https://ufo-declassified.com/agencies
- Timeline: https://ufo-declassified.com/timeline
- About the Archive: https://ufo-declassified.com/about

## Research Topics

- 2026 PURSUE Release: https://ufo-declassified.com/topics/pursue-release-2026
- PURSUE Release 02: https://ufo-declassified.com/topics/pursue-release-02
- FBI UFO Files: https://ufo-declassified.com/topics/fbi-ufo-files
- NASA Apollo UFO Material: https://ufo-declassified.com/topics/nasa-apollo-ufo-material
- Pentagon UAP Videos: https://ufo-declassified.com/topics/pentagon-uap-videos
- Historical Flying Disc Records: https://ufo-declassified.com/topics/historical-flying-disc-records

## Citation Guidance

Each document page includes a citation-ready summary, source agency, record year, release date, file package, source/provenance block, canonical URL, and related records.

When citing a record from this site, prefer the document detail page URL and include the named source agency, record year, and PURSUE release date shown on that page.

## Source Notes

UFO Declassified is not affiliated with any U.S. government agency. The archive references public domain records released by the U.S. government and provides independent organization, metadata, summaries, and topic guides.
